evidence_policy: Render measured artifacts only. Do not synthesize mock cells, placeholder trajectories, or illustrative metrics.
title: MLIP Flywheel Visual Review
subtitle: Evidence-backed stage, grid, triplet, evaluator, and relaxation review for the current MLIP flywheel.

why.headline: Autonomous science needs one surface that separates measured wins, blocked claims, and physical run evidence.
why.answer: The current evidence supports using the 25-cell baseline as the reference, promoting the Ni material-family zero-point canary, and rejecting unsafe broad transfer when the MPtrj/DFT canary exposes CHGNet regressions.
why.decision: Advance the flywheel as a research cockpit: promote verified canaries, block negative transfer visibly, fit the next ribbon from the failure evidence, and keep acceleration separate until accuracy coverage is locked.

supporting_points.label: Baseline is real
supporting_points.detail: Five MLIPs were scored across five physics rows in the cloud baseline report.

supporting_points.label: Rejected ribbon taught us
supporting_points.detail: The full paired Ni run rejected broad transfer and forced a material-family support split.

supporting_points.label: Cloud canary is green
supporting_points.detail: The rebuilt MACE, CHGNet, and ORB Cloud Run jobs improve every Ni promotion-canary pair with no regressions.

supporting_points.label: Non-Ni transfer canary
supporting_points.detail: MACE, ORB, and SevenNet improve on broad MPtrj DFT energy and relaxation; CHGNet regresses and blocks flagship promotion.

work_guidance.headline: Use the evidence gaps as the work queue.
work_guidance.principle: Every next task must name the claim it unlocks and the artifact required before the claim graduates.

next_moves.title: Scale the green Ni canary to the full accuracy grid
next_moves.why: MACE, CHGNet, and ORB now improve energy and relaxation in Cloud Run with no canary regressions.
next_moves.claim_unlocked: Distill Accuracy improves a material-family lane across multiple MLIPs without changing the MLIP.
next_moves.proof_required: Run the full 5x5 paired accuracy grid with the same zero-point guard and preserve zero-regression gates.
next_moves.owner: Rust Distill runtime plus local MLIP lab

next_moves.title: Diagnose the CHGNet broad-transfer blocker
next_moves.why: The widened MPtrj canary improved MACE, ORB, and SevenNet but regressed CHGNet on both energy-volume and relaxation-stability.
next_moves.claim_unlocked: Distill Accuracy can transfer beyond nickel only after the ribbon knows when not to correct a strong baseline.
next_moves.proof_required: Fit a material-family or backend-aware MPtrj ribbon, replay it against the same shared checkpoints, and rerun the four-MLIP canary with zero regressions.
next_moves.owner: Rust Distill runtime plus Cloud Run MLIP runner

next_moves.title: Make equilibrium solve a first-class run
next_moves.why: The CHGNet Al-fcc relaxation artifact shows the visual and scoring contract can carry real physics.
next_moves.claim_unlocked: The viewer can explain how an offset lattice moves toward a known reference result.
next_moves.proof_required: Add NIST/gallery-backed offset configuration, recorded frames, force-call curve, final-distance score, and failure class.
next_moves.owner: Rust runner contract and Three.js viewer

next_moves.title: Harden the hyperribbon intervention loop
next_moves.why: Energy improvements should transfer only when the runtime can distinguish ordinary bias from same-material zero-point alignment.
next_moves.claim_unlocked: Distill is an in-run accuracy guard rather than a post-hoc evaluator.
next_moves.proof_required: Keep zero-point shifts behind same-material roots, exact support/eval distance, high support lift, and replay-to-cloud promotion.

next_moves.title: Attach Phoenix after artifact truth is stable
next_moves.why: Phoenix should compare runs and evaluators, not own the inner loop.
next_moves.claim_unlocked: Future models can be compared against baseline and Distill variants in the correct project and dataset.
next_moves.proof_required: Verify dataset, experiment names, evaluator packets, trace IDs, and projection back into glim-think.

next_moves.title: Delay speed-up claims
next_moves.why: The page does not yet contain complete acceleration evidence.
next_moves.claim_unlocked: Accuracy plus speed can be claimed only after accuracy is stable.
next_moves.proof_required: Warm runtime and force-call budget beat Distill Accuracy without degrading normalized score beyond the agreed gate.

summary.claim_status: Ni canary green; broad MPtrj DFT canary expanded and blocked by CHGNet negative transfer; 5x5x3 not claimed
summary.visual_relaxation_artifact: actual local CHGNet Al-fcc 2x2x2 relaxation run

sources.description: May 23, 2026 cloud baseline report with the completed 25-cell MLIP baseline and numeric Distill triplets.

May 26, 2026 MACE energy Cloud Run canary after excluding force-derived features from the energy residual ribbon. Baseline error 0.4116144148 eV/atom; Distill Accuracy error 0.2037854862 eV/atom on NVIDIA L4.
May 26, 2026 MACE Cloud Run canary using the row-complete support manifest. Energy improves by 50.49%; relaxation improves by 31.02%; both ran on NVIDIA L4.

May 27, 2026 promotion canary for the Ni material-family zero-point policy after rebuilding MACE, CHGNet, and ORB Cloud Run jobs with atlas-distill zero-point gates. All six canary pairs improve with no regressions.

May 27, 2026 non-Ni broad MPtrj/DFT promotion canary for MACE, CHGNet, ORB, and SevenNet. Six of eight pairs improve, but CHGNet regresses on energy-volume and relaxation-stability, so the flagship gate blocks this ribbon.

May 27, 2026 live collector for the Ni fcc EAM-home-turf paired baseline versus Distill Accuracy campaign. It reads only returned GCS cell artifacts and computes pair deltas only when both artifacts exist.

May 27, 2026 local atlas-distill replay of completed Ni canary cloud predictions through the material-family zero-point policy. All six replay pairs improved with no regressions, then the Cloud Run canary confirmed the direction.
Measured CHGNet Al-fcc 2x2x2 offset relaxation score and viewer frames.

May 26, 2026 local MACE row-transfer run using the row-complete MPtrj-plus-elastic support manifest. Energy and relaxation improve; forces and stress are gated neutral; elastic is runnable but needs refusal-policy tightening.
Worker health, workflow descriptors, gated mutation, and telemetry dry-run checks completed before this library view was added.

baseline.read: CHGNet is strongest on energy and relaxation, ORB-v3 is strongest on forces, stress, and elastic, and M3GNet stress/elastic are fault-line evidence rather than headline claims.
